---
title: Glossary
---

This glossary will grow as the technical draft is verified and migrated.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| NADABAS | National Accounts Database System. |
| Add-in | The Excel artifact that hosts the NADABAS VBA project. |
| Exported VBA | Text-based `.bas`, `.cls`, `.frm`, and related `.frx` files stored under `vba/`. |
| Source of truth | The version-controlled representation from which a review or build is performed. For VBA, this is the exported source below `vba/`. |
| Review build | A non-production add-in created from reviewed source for functional verification. |
| Security approval | A narrow, version-controlled exception for one expected scanner finding; it is not a general suppression. |
| ADR | Architecture Decision Record. |
